literal_meaning: কথার গাঁট বা বাঁধন (knot or binding of words)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথার আঁটুনি দেখে সকলে মুগ্ধ হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His restraint in speech impressed everyone.
Wise people maintain restraint in speech.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to 'tying' words to avoid unnecessary talk, rooted in everyday Bengali linguistic traditions.
